notes.title: Zombies have invaded DRENCH
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913843/fcb115179a52089c3ecd465eaea47293d44b2e15.jpg[/img]

DRENCH ZOMBIES IS HERE!

Drench now has a ZOMBIES mode that is already LIVE for those in the Steam Playtest.

You can find it, along with the Snipers Only map "Occupation" in the current Steam build.

There is also a new SMG that can currently be found in the games Mystery Boxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913843/0075eb9543be028b52ecf7f9bed95a9f223d0adb.jpg[/img]

Do expect bugs!

You can connect with me on my official Discord server: discord.gg/R6fERkE

Check out the full patch notes here:

First Update of 2025!

Added 2 new modes:

Snipers Only on the map Occupation

and

Zombies Mode on the map Zombie Arena

(Zombies mode adds a timer, aswell as zombie kill counter!)

Did some minor bug fixes to Winter Home.

Volume Slider still seems to work! :)

***

V2 OF PATCH ADDITIONS:

Added a new weapon (currently only accessible by Mystery Box).

Added Mystery Boxes to CPTF Zone.

Rebalanced Zombies, and added optimizations/cleanups.

notes.title: Winter Home & New Death
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913843/23ee95471ec2dff8729ce5fd1237e0cebe5ad842.png[/img]Happy 

Holidays everyone!

This latest update is not the MAJOR update I have been working on for a while now.

However, this does add a few major things!

The most exciting being that now Players can keep any items in their hotbar when they die, and will only lose/drop items in their inventory that is not equipped to the hotbar/vehicle/quick inventory!

Do expect bugs, as this is a big change that had alot of meddling in the back-end of the game. So please let me know of any bugs you see here!

You can connect with me on my official Discord server: discord.gg/R6fERkE

I have also added a cozy winter map, with a few fun winter additions!

There have also been some audio/gameplay changes in other maps, including the open world. So you may bump into something new and exciting in Drench!

God speed space cowboys.

- Scott (Sayincraft) Warren (Studios)
